authorization.scope: one FDA-published, non-cumulative post-2012 FAERS ASCII quarter for rights, privacy, schema, and aggregate-only capacity inspection
authorization.basis: FDA public quarterly extract plus FDA Website Policies and openFDA CC0 boundary; no formal legal opinion

research_question: Can one frozen public FAERS quarter support a privacy-bounded, non-causal latest-valid-case-version and multi-table foreign-key reconciliation world with authentic 64K/128K dependence?

source.reason: smallest listed post-2012 case/version ASCII quarter with the seven relational tables required by the topology

privacy_policy.production_join_key: ephemeral dense ordinal assigned after latest-version selection; original identifiers and mappings remain outside Git and training text

constraints: the task is relational reconciliation only; no medical causality, incidence, prevalence, comparative safety, or risk conclusion is allowed
raw archive bytes and raw case rows exist only in process memory or an automatically removed temporary directory
reports contain only aggregate counts, archive hash, official URLs, schemas, and field-level exclusion rules
case identifiers and hashes of case identifiers are not reportable
capacity attributable only to case ordinals or repeated row templates is not unique semantic capacity
no candidate generation until rights, privacy, schema, unique capacity, deterministic oracle, remove-one, and 4K/8K/16K shortcut gates pass unchanged
